verdict.rationale: Starting an online filing without first creating an account is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The pack shows no published page documenting a keyless or file-number entry path. The only evidence is two probes that hit HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Those blocks concern automated crawlers, not whether a founder needs an account, and nothing else on either site was fetched.
